name: english-typing-practice
description: Multi-user English typing practice with an admin console

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
